title: Large Digital Kitchen Scale 40kg/88lb, Stainless Steel Price Computing Food Scale with LCD Display for Baking, Deli, Cooking, Meat Prep, Counting Coins, Adapter Included
description:
About this item
High Capacity and Accurate: Up to 40kg/88lb Wide Range - The precision food scale is equipped with an upgraded high-sensitivity build-in sensor with a large weighing range of 40kg and 1g readability.
4 Units: Our versatile industrial counting scale with seamless g/kg/oz/lb conversion units. Designed for efficiency and convenience, this scale simplifies your weighing tasks by effortlessly switching between grams, kilograms, ounces, and pounds, catering to your specific measurement needs. Whether you're managing inventory, packaging products, or conducting quality control checks, our scale offers precise measurements in the units you prefer.
Large LCD Display: This scale features a clear LCD display green backlight, ensuring effortless readability of measurements. Whether you're counting small parts in a warehouse or conducting inventory checks in a retail setting, our scale offers reliable performance and user-friendly operation.
Multiple Uses: This deli market food scale with pricing/weight/PCS/ Tare will be your best companion for your kitchen, catering, farm kiosk, farm stand, grocery store, deli, vegetable store, or bakery store. It is made of Stainless Steel Plate and ABS plastic frame.
2 Power Supply Modes: Experience versatility and reliability with our scale featuring 2 power supply modes. This food scale offers the convenience of both battery and AC power options, ensuring uninterrupted operation in any setting.
